entries.title: Jeremiah 33:1
segments: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:2
segments: So says the LORD the Maker of it, the LORD who formed it in order to establish it; the LORD [is] His name:

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:3
segments: Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and inscrutable things which you do not know.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:4
segments: For so says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down [to defend] against the siege-mounds and against the sword:

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:5
segments: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men whom I have slain in My anger and in My fury, and for all whose evil I have hidden My face from this city.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:6
segments: Behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will heal them and will show them the riches of peace and truth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:7
segments: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:8
segments: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against Me; and I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned, and by which they have transgressed against Me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:9
segments: And it shall be to Me a name of joy, a praise and an honor before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do to them. And they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the riches that I bring to it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:10
segments: So says the LORD: Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say [is] a waste without man and without beast, [even] in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast;

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:11
segments: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts, for the LORD [is] good, for His mercy [endures] forever; and the voice of those who shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause the captivity of the land to return, as at the first, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:12
segments: So says the LORD of hosts: Again in this place which is a desert without man and without beast, and in all its cities, there [shall be] a home of shepherds causing [their] flocks to lie down.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:13
segments: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him who tallies, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:14
segments: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will establish the good thing which I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:15
segments: In those days, and at that time, I will cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. And He shall do judgment and righteousness in the land.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:16
segments: In those days Judah shall be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely. And this [is the name] with which she shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:17
segments: For so says the LORD, David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:18
segments: nor shall the priests the Levites lack a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle grain offerings, and to do sacrifice forever.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:19
segments: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:20
segments: So says the LORD: If you can break My covenant of the day and My covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:21
segments: [then] also may My covenant with David My servant be broken, that he should not have a son to reign on his throne, and [My covenant] with the Levites the priests, My ministers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:22
segments: As the host of the heavens cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so I will multiply the seed of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:23
segments: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:24
segments: Do you not consider what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD has chosen, He has even cast them off? So they have despised My people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:25
segments: So says the LORD: If My covenant [is] not with day and night, [and if] I have not given the ordinances of the heavens and the earth,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:26
segments: then I will cast away the seed of Jacob, and David My servant, [so] that I will not take [any] of his seed [to be] rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will bring back their captivity, and have mercy on them.
